explanation: Orthonormal sets require orthogonal unit vectors. In U, the dot product is (-3+3)/10=0 and both squared norms are (9+1)/10=1. V fails because its first vector has squared norm 4+9+1=14≠1. In W, the dot product is (12-12)/25=0 and both squared norms are (9+16)/25=1. Therefore U and W only are orthonormal.
